TO:		All Parties of Record

FROM:		Commission Advising

RE:	Docket No. 59475 – Joint Application of Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Service Corporation to Amend their Certificates of Convenience and Necessity for the Bell County East Switch to Big Hill Substation 765-KV Transmission Line Project in Bell, Burnet, Concho, Coryell, Lampasas, Llano, Mason, McCulloch, Menard, Milam, Mills, San Saba, Schleicher, Tom Green, and Williamson Counties


DATE:		June 4, 2026  


The Commission voted to add the Appeal of SOAH Order No. 13 of Save the Lampasas to the open meeting scheduled to begin at 9:30 a.m. on June 18, 2026, to consider the merits of the appeal.
